suffix: You are running unattended: don't ask questions, finish the task yourself, and stop once the output file exists.

tasks.label: Product still from a .glb
tasks.prompt: Render a product shot of the 3D model in model.glb and save it as a PNG at out/render.png.

tasks.label: Render a STEP CAD part
tasks.prompt: Render an image of the CAD part in part.step and save it as a PNG at out/render.png.

tasks.label: 3 s turntable MP4 from a .usdz
tasks.prompt: Make a 3-second turntable video (MP4) of the model in model.usdz and save it at out/turntable.mp4.

tasks.label: Bake lighting into a GLB
tasks.prompt: Bake the scene lighting into the textures of model.glb and save the result as a GLB at out/baked.glb.

tasks.label: Mesh → Gaussian splat
tasks.prompt: Convert the mesh in model.glb into a 3D Gaussian splat and save it at out/model.ply (or out/model.spz).
